notes: Two parity chains over the inputs x(1..5), the second in the order of the permutation (I + 1)^3 + 7 mod 5: 13 atoms and 34 constraints. Both chains compute the exclusive-or of every input, so their results cannot differ.
The constraints form a linear system over GF(2) that elimination refutes in polynomial time; resolution needs exponentially many steps as p grows.
